title: Reported Speech 5: Mixed Review (pick the right tool)
description: All four reporting tools (что, ли, Q-word, чтобы) brought together in one review: pick the right linking word, shift the pronouns, and keep the speaker's original tense.
descriptionRussian: Все четыре способа передачи речи («что», «ли», вопросительное слово, «чтобы») собраны вместе: выберите нужный союз, сдвиньте местоимения и сохраните исходное время глагола.
intro: Four tools, and picking between them is entirely about what kind of thing was said. A statement, a yes/no question, a content question, or an order. Three of the four keep the original tense and the fourth always takes a past form. Pronouns shift in all of them, and there is a comma in all of them.
rules: Four tools: что for statements (Lesson 1), ли for yes / no questions (Lesson 2), a question word as the link for content questions (Lesson 3), чтобы + past for commands and wishes about someone else (Lesson 4). The first applicable tool wins.
Pronouns shift to the narrator's point of view: я → он / она; ты → я when you were the one addressed, otherwise он / она.
Tense is kept in statements (что) and questions (ли, question word). Чтобы always takes the past-tense form, which is the shape чтобы requires, not past meaning.
Punctuation: quotation marks and question marks drop; the comma before что / ли / the question word / чтобы is required.
examples: Direct: Маша сказала: «Я устала». Reported: Маша сказала, что она устала. (Statement; что; я → она; tense kept.)
Direct: Антон спросил: «Маша придёт?» Reported: Антон спросил, придёт ли Маша. (Yes / no question; ли on the focus verb.)
Direct: Маша спросила: «Когда ты вернёшься?» Reported: Маша спросила, когда я вернусь. (Content question; когда as the link; ты → я; tense kept.)
Direct: Иван сказал: «Купи хлеб!» Reported: Иван сказал, чтобы я купил хлеб. (Command; чтобы + past form купил.)
Direct: Маша сказала: «Я приду завтра». Reported: Маша сказала, что она придёт завтра. (Statement; что; future kept.)
Direct: Антон спросил: «Где Маша?» Reported: Антон спросил, где Маша. (Content question; где as the link.)

rows.label: Command / request
cells: Мама сказала, чтобы я пошёл домой.

items.promptEnglish: Mom told me to go home.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 4: the linking word for a reported command.
items.explanation: Чтобы links a reported command (Lesson 4), and the past form пошёл is the shape чтобы requires.

items.prompt: Антон спросил, _____ ли Маша на работе.
items.promptEnglish: Anton asked whether Masha was at work.
items.hint: Past tense yes / no question with the feminine subject Маша.
items.explanation: The original question was «Маша была на работе?» (past, feminine). Russian keeps the original tense, and the verb agrees with the feminine subject: была. The verb sits first to host ли.

items.promptEnglish: Masha said that she would come tomorrow.
items.explanation: Что links a reported statement. The future tense придёт is kept exactly as Masha said it: «Я приду завтра».

items.prompt: Маша спросила, _____ я приду на работу.
items.promptEnglish: Masha asked when I would come to work.
items.hint: Content question; question word for time.
items.explanation: Когда is the question word for time (Lesson 3) and links a content question about time.

items.promptEnglish: I want you to go home.
items.hint: Two different subjects (я vs ты); чтобы requires which form?
items.explanation: When the subject of the main clause (я) differs from the subject of the чтобы clause (ты), чтобы takes the past form: пошёл.

items.promptEnglish: Anton said that he was tired.
items.explanation: A reported statement takes что + a finite clause with its original tense: сказал, что он устал.

items.promptEnglish: Lena asked whether Anton was home.
items.hint: A yes/no question: front the focus, then ли.
items.explanation: The reported yes/no question fronts дома and clips ли after it: спросила, дома ли Антон. Ли never stands first.

items.hint: A content question keeps its Q-word.
items.explanation: The static-location Q-word где links the clause: спросила, где я живу.

items.promptEnglish: Mom told me to close the window.
items.hint: Reporting a command: connector + verb form.
items.explanation: A reported command takes чтобы + past: чтобы я закрыл окно.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон сказал, чтобы он уже закончил всю работу.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton said that he had already finished all the work.
errorCorrection.explanation: This reports a statement of fact (the work is done), so the linking word is что: что он уже закончил. Чтобы marks a command, which clashes with уже закончил (an accomplished fact).

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша спросила, когда ты вернусь домой с работы.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha asked when I would return home from work.
errorCorrection.explanation: Masha's original question «когда ты вернёшься?» was addressed to the narrator, so ты shifts to я in the report: когда я вернусь. The verb вернусь (1sg future) agrees with я.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон написал, что теперь он жил в Москве.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton wrote that he now lives in Moscow.
errorCorrection.explanation: Russian keeps the original tense. Anton's words were «теперь я живу в Москве» (present), and теперь confirms an ongoing present state, so живёт stays. The past жил wrongly copies the English back-shift; Russian does not back-shift.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha said that Anton would come.
minimalPairs.explanation: Reported statement opened by сказала, so что is the linking word: сказала is a verb of saying, not asking.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha asked when Anton would come.
minimalPairs.explanation: Reported content question opened by спросила, so когда (the question word for time) is the link: спросила signals a question.

patternRecognition.explanation: Reported statement opened by сказала with a clause linked by что. Lesson 1 tool.
Reported yes / no question opened by спросил with ли attached to the focus word дома. Lesson 2 tool.
Reported content question opened by спросила with the question word когда as the link. Lesson 3 tool.

patternRecognition.sentence: Мама сказала, чтобы я пошёл домой.
patternRecognition.explanation: Reported command opened by сказала with a clause linked by чтобы and a past-form verb (пошёл). Lesson 4 tool.

categorySorting.instruction: Read each reported sentence and sort it by which of the four tools it uses.

items.word: Мама сказала, чтобы я закрыл окно.

reviewVocab.definition: the statement frame: a verb of saying plus что links a reported statement; the original tense is kept. Маша сказала, что она устала.
reviewVocab.example: Антон сказал, что он живёт в Москве.

reviewVocab.definition: the question frames: ли on the focus word reports a yes / no question, and a question word (где, когда, кто...) reports a content question. Tense is kept.
reviewVocab.example: Лена спросила, дома ли Антон. Маша спросила, когда я приду.

reviewVocab.definition: the command frame: чтобы plus a past-form verb reports a command or a wish about someone else; the past form is the shape чтобы requires, not past meaning.
reviewVocab.example: Мама сказала, чтобы я закрыл окно.

reviewVocab.definition: the tense is kept: Russian reports speech in the speaker's original tense and never copies the English back-shift (said he *lived*).
reviewVocab.example: «Я живу в Москве» → Антон сказал, что он живёт в Москве.
